articles.summary: CHICAGO, April 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Chicago Atlantic Real Estate Finance, Inc. (NASDAQ: REFI) ("Chicago Atlantic" or the “Company”), a commercial mortgage real estate investment trust, announced details for the release of its results for the first quarter ended March 31, 2026.
articles.title: Chicago Atlantic Real Estate Finance Schedules First Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call Date
